claude.sample_unit: intervention root claims (balanced cohort, one C1–C3 descendant per condition)

links.outcome: Detector robustness to claim-preserving rewriting, with and without transformation-aware training augmentation
links.effect: Macro-F1 fell from 0.987 to 0.428–0.479 (FNIR) and 0.922 to 0.731–0.781 (Monkeypox). Transformation-aware training raised mpox C1–C3 macro-F1 by 0.148 (9/9 models); FNIR +0.035 (7/9, p=0.164).
links.quote: Transformation-aware training increased mean C1–C3 macro-F1 on unseen Monkeypox roots by 0.148 across nine models (9/9 improved; Wilcoxon p=0.0039) while preserving panel-level C0 performance (+0.004).
